title: How American couples form, in numbers
usableAnswer: Cited national figures (with year and population) for: time from first date to exclusivity, to living together, to marriage; share of marriages preceded by cohabitation; prevalence of one-time casual encounters by age band; breakup, separation and divorce rates by duration; age at first marriage by state. Where no measurement exists, say UNKNOWN so the game labels its number a calibration.
whyItMatters: Couples are being built now. Without measured pacing, every threshold for dating, moving in, marrying and breaking up would be invented.

findings.result: NSFG first-premarital-cohabitation competing outcomes at1 and3years, explicitly2006–2010. They do not identify dates-to-exclusivity or casual encounter rates; no independent annual breakup rolls.
